definition: Hard-connecting two ~1°-off anchor endpoints over several turns via a single two-point boundary-value shoot bakes a large ω error (e.g. 4.25° over 3.1 turns → Band D), even though LM multistart on the EXACT pair is Band A. The endpoints' small position error is amplified by the long propagation. The binding blocker s100/s105 isolated. Cure: a free-ω photometry-window polish (single-wind-lc-window-polish) seeded from the shoot, not the hard shoot itself.
